bucket: Square entries show greater within‑school variability and inconsistent student supports (uneven teacher quality, mixed special‑education/IEP and counseling implementation, polarized student outcomes, and repeated parental advocacy) than circle entries
definition: Many Square reviews contrast transformative, named teachers and successful IEP/counseling outcomes with accounts of disengaged teachers, IEP noncompliance, guidance misplacements, and the need for relentless parent intervention (e.g., ‘one miracle teacher vs many who shouldn’t be teachers,’ ‘IEP ignored…then another parent reports IEP prepared child for college’), producing starkly polarized experiences that Circle reviews do not similarly depict.

bucket: square entries report more frequent and severe student-safety and social-climate problems (bullying, drug/vaping use, fights, gang/weapon incidents, racism/transphobia, self-harm) than circle entries
definition: This bucket captures concrete safety and peer-culture incidents—recurrent bullying/cyberbullying, widespread vaping/drug claims, regular fights and lockdowns, gang presence and weapon threats, racial/religious/anti‑LGBTQ harassment, and even self-harm reports. Examples include statements about vaping in bathrooms, 80% drug use claims, multiple lockdowns/gun threats, anti‑Muslim prejudice, and explicit suicide/self‑harm mentions; circle reviews lack comparable safety incident reporting.

bucket: Square entries document more administrative and governance dysfunction — unresponsiveness, favoritism/athletic/wealth bias, leadership turnover, fiscal scandal and punitive or opaque policies — than circle entries
definition: Raw terms here point to square reviewers alleging nonresponsive administrators and boards, favoritism toward athletes/affluent families, published GPA practices, indictment/levy misuse, frequent principal turnover, and opaque/ vindictive policies — themes distinct from operational or pedagogical complaints.

bucket: Square entries describe more concrete, diverse advanced academic and career-readiness programs and measurable postsecondary outcomes (AP/IB/dual-credit/CTE/academies) than circle entries
definition: This groups reviews that list substantive curricular pathways and quantifiable results—multiple AP/IB/dual‑credit classes, academies, CTE/vocational tracks, dual-enrollment and alumni college/career outcomes (e.g., “a ton of dual credit classes…credits fully transferred,” “IB program…entered UNC with 25 credit hours,” “saved a lot of college tuition money!”). Circle reviews generally omit these concrete program listings and outcome metrics.

bucket: square entries report more failures and strain in student support services, counseling, and special education compliance than circle entries
definition: This bucket contains reports of inadequate, overloaded, or unhelpful counseling and student‑support services and explicit failures to follow IEPs/504s or accommodate students with disabilities in square but not circle (examples: 4 counselors with 400–500 caseloads, counselors 'can barely give any guidance,' repeated IEP noncompliance, refusal to work with military recruiters, mentally disabled students 'constantly not given the right attention'). Reviews are sorted here when they focus on the availability, timeliness, quality, or legal compliance of supports (counseling, special ed, gifted supports, mental‑health services).
